notes: payments-callers allows orchestrator by its SPIFFE ID (matched to the SPIRE assignment) and reporter by Istio's cluster.local ns/sa principal (matched by the ns/sa convention, no SPIRE assignment). search-open allows any authenticated principal: every workload with a resolved SPIFFE ID is a declared caller, and the policy is flagged as broad.
